style.backgroundSystem: champagne-cream gradient studio backdrop #F6ECD0 for most screens, warm porcelain white #FBF7EA and #FFFDF4 for spec and recipe screens, one deep vermilion red #C23A2B panel for the texture contrast shot

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm premium nourishment visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of champagne cream #F6ECD0, deep coffee brown #5C4322, vermilion red #C23A2B and one gilt-gold accent #C9A02C; warm soft studio lighting with a gentle top-front key around 3800K, golden glow along glass edges and soft contact shadows; a single elegant modern serif family for all headlines and labels; consistent rounded rectangular info labels and solid rounded cards; consistent thin-line icons in the gilt-gold accent; clean high-end warm product photography on champagne stone, pale rattan and porcelain surfaces, mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero angle for the jar group and stable product scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no brush calligraphy lettering, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no floating product without contact shadow.
noDrift: no floating product without contact shadow
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle for the jar group, consistent jar scale across the set, product always resting on a real surface with a soft contact shadow, never floating
style.surfaceSystem: light champagne stone, pale woven rattan mat and glossy porcelain bowls
style.typography: one elegant modern serif family for all headlines and labels; no brush calligraphy, handwriting, retro or cartoon lettering
